notes: The single definition of every Deskway message. Go (internal/proto), Rust (crates/wire) and JS (web/static/js/proto.js) are checked against it by contract tests. docs/protocol.md is the readable version.
version.json defines the current protocol version. The minimum supported host version is current minus one.
Field types: string, integer, number, boolean, object, array (with items), map (object with arbitrary keys, with values), any, or the name of an entry in types. enum restricts a string.
status: current = on the wire today (possibly with new fields, which carry their own status); new = introduced in the version named by since.
Receivers ignore fields they do not know. Senders only send what the peer's version and caps allow.

capabilities.name: input
capabilities.meaning: The host applies input. Absent: view-only host; the browser hides input controls and sends no input.

capabilities.name: files
capabilities.meaning: The file channel works: files and images can be sent to the host.

capabilities.name: clipboard
capabilities.meaning: The shared clipboard (cb, cbreq, cbdata, cberr, clipshare) works.

capabilities.name: cursor
capabilities.meaning: The host stops drawing the pointer into the video on lc and reports cs and cp.

capabilities.name: displays
capabilities.meaning: The host reports its displays and switches on display.

capabilities.name: start-display
capabilities.meaning: The host starts video on the display requested in the offer.

capabilities.name: relmouse
capabilities.meaning: The host applies relative moves (mr) for Pointer Lock sessions.

capabilities.name: layout
capabilities.meaning: The host reports its keyboard layout's key labels (layout).

capabilities.name: chars
capabilities.meaning: The host resolves characters with modifiers through its own layout (kc).

capabilities.name: capture
capabilities.meaning: The host reports when nothing can be captured (capture).

capabilities.name: desk
capabilities.meaning: The host reports which input desktop is active (desk): lock screen, secure prompts.

capabilities.name: terminal
capabilities.meaning: The host offers a data-only browser terminal on its desk seat.

capabilities.name: terminal-keep
capabilities.meaning: The host keeps the browser terminal across sessions and supports explicit termination.

capabilities.name: terminals
capabilities.meaning: The host keeps multiple browser terminals and accepts open.id and open.new. Browsers and servers also announce it to receive terminal IDs and lists.

capabilities.name: terminal-takeover
capabilities.meaning: The desktop host supports taking a terminal attachment between the browser and the computer. Servers and browsers also announce it to forward or receive TerminalStatus.here.

capabilities.name: browse
capabilities.meaning: The data-only browser session also offers the browse channel for the host user’s files.

capabilities.name: file-transfer
capabilities.meaning: The data-only browser session can upload and download regular files.

capabilities.name: ai
capabilities.meaning: The host takes AI clients on its AI seat, beside a person's session (docs/architecture.md, "AI control"); its status reports that seat and the AI state.

capabilities.name: relay-rtt
capabilities.meaning: The host accepts relay-list on its signaling socket and reports UDP round-trip times.

capabilities.name: vitals
capabilities.meaning: The host reports load and signaling latency when requested in thumbs.
